programme.name: AB-Cloud Research Programme
programme.author: Isaev I. Kh. (Исаев Исхак Хамзатович)
programme.one_line: One study in eight levels: the algebraic AB (Aharonov-Bohm) architecture as a computing fabric, its Dirac skeleton, the Hilbert-Polya bridge, the blind verification apparatus, the Meridian spectral observatory, the vortex-density optimization, and the hyperbolic wave attractors.

honest_boundary.statement: Everything in this package is a numerical and formal study of a mathematical model. It does NOT prove the Riemann hypothesis. The V13 obligation machine keeps the RH conclusion blocked (verdict: blocked) while the analytic prerequisites remain assumed.
